subject: Archaeology
title: Monte Albán: City in the Clouds
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Monte Albán: City in the Clouds.

hook.text: The Zapotec people flattened an entire mountaintop in Mexico to build a city above the clouds.

buildup.text: Monte Albán thrived for 1,300 years starting around 500 BCE, housing 25,000 people at its peak.

discovery.text: Alfonso Caso excavated it in 1931 and found Tomb 7 — one of the richest burials ever found in the Americas.

twist.text: The tomb's gold and jade treasures were Mixtec, not Zapotec. A later culture reused the Zapotec burial.

climax.text: The Zapotec had writing, astronomy, and a calendar before the Maya, but history barely remembers them.

punchline.text: They built a city on a mountain and still got overlooked by history.

quiz.question: What surprise did Tomb 7 at Monte Albán reveal?
options: It contained Roman coins proving transatlantic contact
The rich treasures inside were Mixtec, not Zapotec — a later culture reused the burial
The tomb was empty, suggesting it had been robbed in antiquity
